tools.name: finance_search
tools.description:
Search financial data and return an answer with an inline widget.

    Covers stocks, macro, forex, crypto, commodities, earnings, technicals,
    and related market questions. Pass the user's question in `query` without
    rephrasing.

    To screen a named watchlist or portfolio, call list_watchl

tools.name: earnings_rag
tools.description:
Retrieve what was said on earnings calls, plus the print and the price move.

    Use this for one season across several names, or this season versus a
    prior season. Pass tickers you already have, or a sector label such as
    Financials or Technology. Banks, insurers, and brokers are Financials

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description:
List the authenticated user's watchlists and their symbols.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many lists (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.description:
Create a watchlist with the given name and ticker symbols.

    Args:
        name: Watchlist name
        symbols: List of stock symbols (e.g. ["AAPL", "MSFT"])

tools.name: update_watchlist
tools.description:
Update a watchlist's name and/or symbols.

    Args:
        watchlist_id: The watchlist UUID
        name: New name (optional)
        symbols: Updated list of symbols (optional)

tools.name: list_screeners
tools.description:
List the authenticated user's saved screeners (filter queries + schedule).

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many screeners (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: create_screener
tools.description:
Save a screener filter query for scheduled enter/exit (joiner/leaver) notifies.

    Same rows as Terminal Save on /screener. Pass last_symbols (current matches)
    or call run_screener after create to seed the baseline; later runs notify
    names that enter or leave when Settings Screener in & ou

tools.name: update_screener
tools.description:
Update a saved screener's name, query, schedule, or baseline symbols.

    Args:
        screener_id: The screener UUID from list_screeners
        name: New name (optional)
        query: Updated filter blob (optional)
        schedule: "off", "daily", or "weekly" (optional; weekly requires Pro)

tools.name: delete_screener
tools.description:
Delete a saved screener by ID.

    Args:
        screener_id: The screener UUID from list_screeners

tools.name: run_screener
tools.description:
Re-run a saved screener; persist last_symbols; return entered/exited.

    First seed does not notify. Later runs notify joiners and leavers when
    Settings Screener in & out is on. Same path as Terminal Run now.

    Args:
        screener_id: The screener UUID from list_screeners

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description:
List the authenticated user's agent-rail strategies (id, name, active, color).

    Does not include full markdown — use get_strategy for the live playbook text,
    settings, and links. Strategy writes require the Terminal browser or agent.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description:
Read one strategy's current or historical generation (markdown, settings, links).

    The playbook text is returned in full. It is not cut at the usual response size.

    Args:
        strategy_id: Strategy UUID from list_strategies
        generation: Optional GCS generation for an older save (fr

tools.name: list_strategy_versions
tools.description:
List saved generations for a strategy (newest first, with version notes).

    Args:
        strategy_id: Strategy UUID from list_strategies

tools.name: tag_activity
tools.description:
Mark one action as belonging to a strategy already on this account.

    Call list_strategies first and pass that id. The playbook stays read-only.
    This only writes the activity tag. kind is decision, tool_call, order,
    alert_set, library_save, screener_run, or query. tool is mcp, portfolios,

tools.name: list_portfolios
tools.description:
List the authenticated user's portfolios.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many portfolios (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: create_portfolio
tools.description:
Create a portfolio with a name and base currency.

    Args:
        name: Portfolio name
        currency: Base currency (default USD)

tools.name: add_transaction
tools.description:
Add a buy, sell, deposit, withdrawal, dividend, short, or cover to a portfolio.

    Attach an investment case with library_item_id. That is the document id.
    search_library returns it as item_id. list_library_items returns it as id.
    Pass the id, not the title. The accept card and the transac

tools.name: edit_order
tools.description:
Change an open portfolio order. Use this before cancel_order.

    Attach or replace the investment case with library_item_id. That is the
    document id. search_library returns it as item_id. list_library_items
    returns it as id. Pass the id, not the title. An empty library_item_id
    removes

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description:
Cancel an open portfolio order. No fill is written.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
        order_id: The order UUID

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description:
Get current holdings with quantity, cost basis, market value, and unrealized P&L.

    A short has negative shares, a positive avg_cost, a negative total_cost_book
    (the open credit), and a negative market value. Unrealized profit is positive.
    Cash includes short proceeds and is reduced when

tools.name: get_portfolio_rules
tools.description:
Read the order limits for a portfolio.

    Call this before add_transaction on a buy, sell, short, or cover.
    The rules say which assets are allowed and how large an order may be.
    This tool cannot change the rules.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID

tools.name: get_portfolio_statistics
tools.description:
Get portfolio performance statistics (returns, allocation, risk).

    gross_exposure and net_exposure are in book currency. A weight may be
    negative. dividend_income is cash by stock and can be negative when a
    short owes the dividend. total_gain is unrealized_pnl + realized_pnl.
    Do not

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description:
List price, event, and clock alerts for the authenticated user.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many alerts (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description:
Create a price alert, an event alert, or a clock.

    Calling this stores the alert. A clock may omit the ticker.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol (e.g. "AAPL"). Required for price and event alerts. Optional for a clock.
        alert_type: "target_price", "movement_pct", "event", or "schedu

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description:
Get alert notifications. Unread only, unless history is set.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many rows (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100). Unread upstream cap is 50.
        history: When true, return fired alerts including ones already read, newest first.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description:
Delete an alert by ID.

    Args:
        alert_id: The alert UUID

tools.name: list_library_folders
tools.description:
List folders in the authenticated user's research library.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many folders (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: create_library_folder
tools.description:
Create a library folder, optionally nested under a parent.

    Args:
        name: Folder name
        parent_id: Parent folder UUID (optional — omit for a root folder)

tools.name: rename_library_folder
tools.description:
Rename a library folder.

    Args:
        folder_id: The folder UUID
        name: New folder name

tools.name: move_library_folder
tools.description:
Move a library folder under a different parent (or to root).

    Args:
        folder_id: The folder UUID to move
        parent_id: New parent folder UUID (omit / null for library root)

tools.name: delete_library_folder
tools.description:
Delete a library folder and everything inside it.

    Args:
        folder_id: The folder UUID

tools.name: list_library_items
tools.description:
List documents in a library folder, or at the root if no folder is given.

    Args:
        folder_id: Folder UUID to list (optional — omit for root-level items)
        offset: Skip this many items (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.description:
Get a library document's metadata and content.

    Content is markdown, raw HTML (content_type text/html), or a signed URL for PDFs.

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

tools.name: create_library_item
tools.description:
Create a markdown or HTML document in the research library.

    Args:
        title: Document title
        content: Markdown body, or raw HTML when content_type is text/html
        folder_id: Folder UUID (optional — omit for library root)
        content_type: text/markdown (default) or text/html

tools.name: update_library_item
tools.description:
Update a library document's title and/or content (content edits create a new version).

    Content is markdown, or raw HTML when the document is already text/html.
    The document type does not change.

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID
        title: New title (optional)
        content: N

tools.name: move_library_item
tools.description:
Move a library document into a different folder (or to root).

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID to move
        folder_id: Destination folder UUID (omit / null for library root)

tools.name: delete_library_item
tools.description:
Delete a library document and all of its stored versions.

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

tools.name: list_library_item_versions
tools.description:
List version history for a library document (newest first).

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

tools.name: search_library
tools.description:
Full-text search across the authenticated user's library documents.

    Args:
        query: Search terms
        limit: Max results (default 20, capped at 50)

tools.name: list_journal
tools.description:
List generated daily research journal entries (most recent first).

    Entries appear only after the automatic end-of-day journal generation run.
    Drafts from submit_journal_draft are not listed until that run completes.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many entries (default 0)
        limit

tools.name: get_journal_entry
tools.description:
Get a full generated journal entry by ID from list_journal.

    Draft ids from submit_journal_draft are not readable until end-of-day
    generation; use list_journal after the daily run for valid entry ids
    (integer or legacy UUID).

    Args:
        entry_id: Journal entry id from list_journa

tools.name: submit_journal_draft
tools.description:
Submit a journal draft for a day. Same-day resubmissions are retained as separate drafts.

    The draft is accepted immediately but the readable daily journal entry is
    generated automatically at end of day; it then appears in list_journal.
    The returned draft id is not a list_journal / get_j

tools.name: run_deepdive
tools.description:
Queue a full DeepDive suite for a stock using a monthly custom-run grant.

    Prepaid search credits cannot pay for this. Free plans have 0 runs;
    Basic has 10/month; Pro has 50/month. Re-running a ticker already
    unlocked this month does not consume another grant. The call returns
    as soo

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description:
Log a bug in the same inbox as the terminal bug button (5 per user per day).

    Use only when the user asks, or when you have confirmed a real data/UI
    error. Do not file speculative bugs. Pass ticker/section so admins get a
    terminal URL; page_url is optional if it is already a terminal.man

tools.name: marketing_inbox
tools.description:
Admin only. Latest teasers plus already-generated images.

    Use ticker for all current items on a symbol, type for one content_type
    across symbols, or since for the worker poll. Then call
    marketing_graphics(content_id) for live formats. Reuse items[].images[]
    when the option you want

tools.name: marketing_graphics
tools.description:
Admin only. Live formats for one inbox item, or the catalog.

    For a bot, pass content_id from marketing_inbox. Empty options means skip
    the item. Already-rendered images are included so you can reuse a cache hit.

    Args:
        content_id: gc:{id} or rd:{uuid} — live formats for that ite

tools.name: marketing_render
tools.description:
Admin only. Render one live format and wait until image.url exists.

    Blocks until GCS has the PNG (or a cache hit). Do not poll. Draft
    formats return option_not_live.

    Args:
        content_id: gc:{id} or rd:{uuid}
        option_id: live option from marketing_graphics
        force: Byp

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_notifications" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: earnings_rag, tag_activity, add_transaction, get_notifications, get_library_item, report_bug · Private data: add_transaction, edit_order, list_library_items, get_library_item, create_library_item, update_library_item, move_library_item, delete_library_item, list_library_item_versions, search_library, run_deepdive, report_bug · Public sink: finance_search, create_screener, run_screener, add_transaction, edit_order, create_alert, submit_journal_draft · Destructive: delete_screener, run_screener, delete_alert, delete_library_folder, delete_library_item, list_journal, get_journal_entry, run_deepdive, marketing_graphics, marketing_render.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: earnings_rag, tag_activity, add_transaction, get_notifications, get_library_item, report_bug · Private data: add_transaction, edit_order, list_library_items, get_library_item, create_library_item, update_library_item, move_library_item, delete_library_item, list_library_item_versions, search_library, run_deepdive, report_bug · Public sink: finance_search, create_screener, run_screener, add_transaction, edit_order, create_alert, submit_journal_draft · Destructive: delete_screener, run_screener, delete_alert, delete_library_folder, delete_library_item, list_journal, get_journal_entry, run_deepdive, marketing_graphics, marketing_render

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
